data.name: Pramod Bavchikar
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Pramod Bavchikar has made a big mark in cricket. With 11 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 42, with an average of 10.90 and a quick strike rate of 132.93. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 3 sixes and 11 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 12.1 overs, taking 7 wickets at an economy rate of 8.05. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
